title: useless additions
description: a mod that adds some useful and useless utilities
body:
**(THIS MOD IS STILL IN ALPHA, IT DOESN'T HAVE A LOT OF FEATURES)**

this mod adds useful and useless things, useful like a structure that has a lot of OP loot, and useless like a diamond stick that has no use currently, and more to be discover

i made this mod just to have fun and hoping that people will like my work since thi is my first mod

I don't know why you would wanna download it, maybe to have fun?

this mod is small and I'm planning to add more in the future

**Geckolib is required**

**download geckolib here:** https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/version/jK2C8NsI
